sources.observed_relation: # Roadmap: independent MagicSchool feature-parity options for ASFAI Education ## Purpose and research boundary This issue is a selectable implementation backlog, not a proposal to copy MagicSchool's proprietary prompts, model configurations, source code, or visual design. It describes independently designed ASFAI capabilities that provide comparable educational jobs-to-be-done on top of ASFAI's open, MCP-first, evidence-centered architecture. Inventory snapshot: **2026-08-23**. MagicSchool's public [Master Tools List](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ZTK7X2D8R_uqYW8SF9sejnkpBCQzMz_qVXS9G_Rhag0/edit?usp=sharing) contains 100 educator category rows representing **88 unique educator tools** (12 are cross-listed), plus **51 student tools**. Twenty-one names appear in both lists, producing **118 unique named tools across both audiences**. The matrices below evaluate every unique educator tool and every student-facing tool, including the overlaps because their student delivery and safety requirements differ.
